guidetextdraw_1232846586._value: The CSUF Volunteer Release Form for Minors must be completed and signed by a parent/guardian. The form can be found on the Risk Management website. Once signed, upload the completed form to the Supporting Documents tab.
guidetextdraw_1232846586.name: riskmanagementtext

guidetextdraw_1748598971._value: * Have you volunteered at CSUF in the past?
guidetextdraw_1748598971.name: textdraw_17485989711694631920672

guidetextdraw_1186040488._value: If yes, please provide your volunteer supervisor’s name and extension.
guidetextdraw_1186040488.name: IfYesPleaseText

guidetextdraw._value: Volunteer service is limited to a maximum of one year. Renewals require submission of a new volunteer registration form.
guidetextdraw.name: textdraw1697609395266

guidetextdraw_105099._value: Note: All volunteers must complete required training prior to the start of their service.
guidetextdraw_105099.name: textdraw_10509931901694670547871

guidetextdraw_237238062.name: textdraw_2372380621782907580741
